Please, save the provided data frames in RDS format in the `dataframes` folder. ::: {.cell} ```{.r .cell-code} # Load the BOX_PATH environment variable FOLDER_PATH <- Sys.getenv("BOX_PATH") # Define subdirectories within the Box folder dataframes_folder <- file.path(FOLDER_PATH, "dataframes") outputs_folder <- file.path(FOLDER_PATH, "outputs/CFUs") if (!dir.exists(outputs_folder)) { dir.create(outputs_folder, recursive = TRUE) } ``` ::: ::: {.cell} ```{.r .cell-code} # Read the provided RDS file dataframeID <- "DatCol" CFUs_HNO_Cps <- readRDS(file.path(dataframes_folder, paste0(dataframeID, "_CFUs_HNO_Cps.rds"))) # Filter the data to include only the 24-hour time point CFUs_HNO_Cps <- CFUs_HNO_Cps %>% filter(time == "24") ``` ::: Log-transformed CFU/HNO-ALI between groups were compared using a LMM to determine statistical significance with `culture` and `strain` as fixed effects and experimental date as a random effect (line was singular). All pairwise contrasts were performed and adjusted for multiple comparisons using the Holm method. A `sign` annotation column was created to indicate which comparisons are statistically significant with p<0.05. Vertical brackets represent model-predicted mean values and confidence intervals (± 2 × SEM), back-transformed to the original response scale. ::: {.cell} ```{.r .cell-code} # Run the mixed model with emmeans contrasts stats_results_Cps <- mixed_model_with_emmeans( input_data = CFUs_HNO_Cps, response = "CFU_HNO", log_response = TRUE, adjust = "holm", fixed_effects = c("culture", "strain"), random_effects1 = "date" ) stats_formated_Cps <- format_stats_results(stats_results_Cps, grouping_vars = c("condition", "culture_pair")) # Save the stats results saveRDS(stats_formated_Cps, file.path(outputs_folder, "stats_results_HNO_CFUs_CocultureCps.rds")) ``` ::: ::: {.cell} ```{.r .cell-code} # Render the results cat("Model Formula:", format(stats_results_Cps$model_formula)) ``` ::: formated_stats_results$input_data) + geom_jitter( aes(x = {{ x_var }}, y = {{ y_var }}, fill = {{ fill_var }}, shape = {{ shape_var }}), size = 4, stroke = 0.01, width = 0.2, color = "white") + geom_point(data = formated_stats_results$predictions, aes(x = {{ x_var }}, y = predicted_mean), shape = 3, size = 1) + geom_errorbar(data = formated_stats_results$predictions, aes(x = {{ x_var }}, y = predicted_mean, ymin = predicted_lower, ymax = predicted_upper), width = .15) + facet_grid2( cols = vars({{ facet_var }}), scales = "free_x", space = "free_x", strip = strip_themed(background_x = elem_list_rect(fill = facet_colors)), labeller = if (!is.null(facet_labels)) labeller(.cols = facet_labels) else label_value ) + scale_fill_manual(values = fill_colors, name = fill_title) + math_format(10^.x))) + labs(x = title_x, y = title_y) + theme_bw() + theme( panel.grid = element_blank(), panel.spacing = unit(0, "lines"), strip.text.x = element_markdown(size = 14, face = "bold",
